create.name: Dr. Deborah Ooten
create.bio:
Dr. Deborah Ooten is an Enneagram teacher and coach who founded and co-owns the Conscious Living Center, a community of coaches and Enneagram practitioners in Ohio. She holds a doctorate in clinical psychology, is a certified teacher in the Narrative Tradition of the Enneagram, and trained in Spiral Dynamics with Don Beck. Her signature contribution is bringing the two maps together, reading the nine personality types alongside the levels of human development so that students can see both the habits of their type and the wider stage of consciousness they are living from. She is an Accredited Professional of the International Enneagram Association.

At the centre she leads her School of Conscious Living, a course of study lasting two years that now meets live on Zoom. The first part looks closely at the types, wings, instincts and the three centres of mind, heart and body; the second turns to relationships and development, and graduates may go on to certify as Enneagram teachers. An advanced monthly group draws on Gurdjieff's Fourth Way for longer-term inner work. She also coaches individuals and teams, consults for businesses through Conscious Dynamics, and has produced recorded Enneagram panels, interviews with people of each type and guided Enneagram meditations made with her late colleague Ron Esposito.

courses.title: Coaching Sessions with Dr. Deborah Ooten
courses.description: One-to-one coaching that uses the Enneagram and levels of consciousness to look at patterns in work, relationships and inner life. Sessions are held online; packages of four and ten are also offered.

courses.title: Enneagram Emersion (School of Conscious Living)
courses.description: The core programme of her school, taught live online over roughly eight months in two parts. Part one studies the nine types, wings, instincts and centres in depth; part two adds Spiral Dynamics and adult development, and can lead to teacher certification.

courses.title: Enneagram Panels - Moderated by Dr Deborah Ooten
courses.description: Recordings of panels in which people of each of the nine types talk about their lives while Ooten draws out how the type shapes their outlook. A way to learn the types from first-hand accounts.

courses.title: Enneagram Exemplar DVD
courses.description: Ooten interviews friends, colleagues and clients who represent each type, asking how they came to understand their own patterns and grow beyond them.

courses.title: Lifting the Veil - Enneagram Meditations by Dr. Deborah Ooten and Ron Esposito
courses.description: Guided meditations made with Ron Esposito in the Narrative Tradition of the Enneagram, designed to help listeners notice and soften the habits of their type.

free_resources.title: Free Enneagram Test
free_resources.description: An online questionnaire from the Conscious Living Center to help you find your likely Enneagram type, as a starting point for further study.
